parsed.answer: Source 4547102 shows that the H3K9 demethylases KDM4D and KDM4E mediate active H3K9me3/2 demethylation in IVF embryos but are deficiently expressed in SCNT embryos at EGA, and that ectopic overexpression of KDM4E restores the global transcriptome, improves blastocyst formation, and increases SCNT cloning efficiency. This directly supports the claim that H3K9me3 removal via ectopic H3K9 demethylase expression improves reprogramming efficiency in SCNT. Source 11532659 concerns H3(T118) phosphorylation and nucleosome remodeling and provides no evidence on H3K9me3 demethylation or SCNT.
